title: Adaptive dual-geometry fusion screen
hypothesis: A confidence-adaptive fusion of local-manifold RBF evidence and global prototype-regularized linear evidence improves difficult-class recognition while preserving confident RBF decisions.

selection_rule.screen_success: best adaptive arm improves by at least 0.50 percentage points over 86.10%
selection_rule.safety_report: class-level positive/negative recall changes and class bootstrap interval
selection_rule.confirmation: Freeze a single winning arm and run unchanged on episodes 2 and 3.
